Field-order artefacts

Failure signal

A field-order artefacts condition is reported or detected during picture.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for picture does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Step through motion and inspect declared versus actual field dominance.

Corrective action

Correct field interpretation before one controlled deinterlace or re-encode.

Prevention

Add this verification to the picture gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
